title: BGM2Pose: Active 3D Human Pose Estimation with Non-Stationary Sounds
abstract: arXiv:2503.00389v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose BGM2Pose, a non-invasive 3D human pose estimation method using arbitrary music (e.g., background music) as active sensing signals. Unlike existing approaches that significantly limit practicality by employing intrusive chirp signals within the audible range, our method utilizes natural music that causes minimal discomfort to humans. Estimating human poses from standard music presents significant challenges. In contrast to sound sources specifically designed for measurement, regular music varies in both volume and pitch. These dynamic changes in signals caused by music are inevitably mixed with alterations in the sound field resulting from human motion, making it hard to extract reliable cues for pose estimation. translated_title: BGM2Pose：基于非平稳声音的主动式三维人体姿态估计
translated_abstract: 我们提出了BGM2Pose，一种使用任意音乐（如背景音乐）作为主动感知信号的无创三维人体姿态估计方法。与现有方法在可听范围内使用侵入式啁啾信号从而严重限制实用性不同，我们的方法利用自然音乐，对人体造成的不适极小。从普通音乐中估计人体姿态面临重大挑战：与专门为测量设计的声源不同，普通音乐在音量和音调上都会变化。音乐引起的信号动态变化不可避免地与人体运动引起的声场变化混合在一起，使得难以提取可靠的姿态估计线索。为了解决这些挑战，BGM2Pose引入了一个对比姿态提取模块，该模块采用对比学习和难负样本采样，从录制数据中消除音乐成分，将运动信息分离出来。
tldr: 提出BGM2Pose方法，首次利用任意背景音乐作为主动感知信号，并通过对比学习和难负样本采样消除音乐成分的干扰，实现无创且实用的三维人体姿态估计。
en_tdlr: BGM2Pose enables non-invasive 3D human pose estimation using arbitrary background music as active sensing signals, employing contrastive learning with hard negative sampling to eliminate musical components from the recorded audio.
